name: task-board
description: A task board per project, opened with /task-board: lanes for ideas, todo, in progress and done, tasks with keys, details and priority, saved prompt snippets, and a row above the prompt that creates tasks while Claude works. A prompt that names a task key gets its details attached for Claude.

claudeTool.title: Tool for Claude
claudeTool.description: Gives Claude a tool to list, read, create and update the tasks, so it can pick the next one or move one to Done. Its name goes along with every request.
